messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Increased 5xx errors on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1). Pager triggered for eng-oncall. Please acknowledge if you're taking this.

maria_oncall: acked — I'm on it. grabbing logs and initial impact numbers.

kamal_sre: seeing spike in kv-cache miss rate and downstream token-generation latency. correlated with a rollout of quantized v2.3. Patch notes show different kernel selection.

jules_research: aligning — our benchmarks showed higher memory pressure for that quant profile at long seqs. could be causing more KV flushes.

maria_oncall: customer impact: ~12% of requests hitting 500s over the last 6m, primarily longer (>1024) contexts. Support ticket surge flagged for two customers (acct: fincorp / edu-saas). CCing cecilia.

cecilia_support: noted. I've opened emergency incident tickets with both customers and offered fallback to earlier model. They want ETA before rollback.

sam_engineer: quick mitigation idea: revert routing to model:v2.2 for hosted tier while we triage v2.3 quant. Can we do a canary rollback?

kamal_sre: we can route 90% -> v2.2, 10% -> v2.3 for monitoring. I'll kick the traffic policy change.

maria_oncall: doing that now: `rb set-route /v1/generate --from model:v2.3 --to model:v2.2 --pct 90 --dry=false`

incident-bot: Deploy change recorded: #deploy-7882 by maria_oncall. Routing update took effect at 1755551350.

sam_engineer: after routing change, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.8% in 4m. latency tail improved. good stopgap.

jules_research: I'll reproduce locally with the v2.3 quant profile and long sequences to capture the cache eviction behavior. suspect failure mode: increased per-request KV eviction leading to miss storms.

kamal_sre: collecting kernel logs and GPU memory patterns now. pushing metrics to incident dashboard: kv.miss_rate, kv.evictions, batch.latency_p95, quant.kernel_fallbacks.

maria_oncall: status update for execs: routing reverted to stable -> majority on v2.2, customer impact reduced. Scheduling postmortem.

cecilia_support: customers informed, support cases updated. They requested postmortem summary when available.

maria_oncall: postmortem scheduling — proposing 1755630000 (next day 10am PT). Who can attend: kamal, jules, sam, cecilia?

kamal_sre: I can. I'll bring kernel logs and a remediation plan draft.

jules_research: available. I'll bring repro steps and perf diffs.

sam_engineer: available. I can prepare rollback checklist and a prioritized action list for engineering.

cecilia_support: I'll attend to capture customer-facing notes and SLA impact.

maria_oncall: action items (assigning here):
- kamal_sre: dig into kv eviction root cause, propose immediate config changes (eviction_threshold, cache_ttl) + timeline (by EOD).
- jules_research: reproduce quantization regression, test alternative kernel flags and quant params, submit PR with tests (by EOD).
- sam_engineer: prepare automated routing rollback runbook + smoke tests, and implement monitoring alert for kv.miss_rate > 5% (by EOD).
- cecilia_support: consolidate customer impact doc and update customers with ETA for postmortem (by EOD).

kamal_sre: noted. I'll start with increased cache size + conservative eviction_policy and run a canary. If that reduces evictions, we can avoid full rollback next time.

jules_research: on repro, found that per-layer quant rounding triggers extra attention masking which increases intermediate memory. I'll try toggling kernel fallback flag `KERNEL_ALLOW_FALLBACK=false` and measure.

sam_engineer: adding monitoring alert: `alert: KVCacheHighMiss rate > 5% for 3m` -> pager to eng-oncall. will PR in a few mins.

incident-bot: Action logged: Created ticket INF-3421 (Remediation: kv-cache + quant regression). Assigned: kamal_sre, jules_research, sam_engineer.

maria_oncall: thanks. Please update the ticket with any config changes and link to test runs. We'll use INF-3421 as the canonical tracker.

cecilia_support: customers updated. asked them to validate if they see improvements after routing change.

kamal_sre: initial canary with eviction_threshold +20% looks promising — evictions down ~60% in canary. Pushing a broader canary to 20% traffic for 30m.

maria_oncall: tracking: canary started at 1755552900.

sam_engineer: integration note — if canary fails, automated fallback will route canary traffic back to v2.2. I've ensured the rollback hook is armed.

jules_research: continuing quant experiments. found a config that stabilizes memory at long seqs but adds ~4% latency; quant accuracy unchanged. Will document trade-offs in INF-3421.

maria_oncall: final update: canary stable at 20% for 35m with reduced evictions and acceptable latency. We'll roll forward config change to 100% during low traffic window tonight with follow-up monitoring. Postmortem scheduled and action owners assigned in INF-3421.

cecilia_support: closing high-priority customer tickets as 'mitigated' pending postmortem.

kamal_sre: follow-up items I'll add to INF-3421: metric dashboards, backstop configs, and a regression test for long-context quant memory.

jules_research: I'll add detailed repro steps and perf vectors to INF-3421 and link the PR when ready.

sam_engineer: created PR for alerting + rollback automation: #repo/infra/pull/912. Adding runbook snippet: ```
1) run `rb set-route /v1/generate --to model:v2.2 --pct 100`
2) verify smoke: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"<>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.error'`
3) monitor kv.miss_rate and batch.latency_p95 for 5m
```

maria_oncall: thanks everyone — closing live incident. Please keep INF-3421 up to date and we'll cover remaining action items in tomorrow's postmortem. :white_check_mark:
